OpenAI just released a model that watches your screen and takes action across applications — for $1 per million input tokens.

GPT-6.1 Terra launched on October 26 with three capabilities that matter for business: screen understanding, cross-app execution, and dramatically reduced API pricing. It is rolling out to Enterprise, Plus, Pro, and Edu customers through ChatGPT Work and Codex.

Here is what changes for executive teams. The automation business case just got rewritten. Workflows that previously required custom integrations, RPA platforms, or engineering sprints to automate can now be handled by a foundation model that observes and acts within existing tools. At this price point, the ROI threshold drops low enough to justify automation across mid-tier operational processes — not just the high-volume, high-value ones.

The broader industry trend is unmistakable: pricing is shifting from cost-per-token to cost-per-completed-task. Organizations still budgeting AI by token volume are measuring the wrong thing.

If you have not re-evaluated your automation roadmap in the last 90 days, the landscape has moved beneath you.
